geographic_breadth.block_sign_counts: count negative, positive, and exact-zero C-minus-R3 block means across all 168 frozen confirmatory blocks
geographic_breadth.bioregion_summary: within each of 12 frozen bioregions, equal-weight mean of its block means plus negative-block fraction
geographic_breadth.generality_readout: number of bioregions with negative regional block-mean effect

external_state_associations.block_covariate: equal-island mean of the frozen standardized response-independent state values within each block
external_state_associations.statistic: Spearman rank correlation between block C-minus-R3 and block covariate mean
external_state_associations.interpretation: descriptive moderator pattern only; no multiple-testing-adjusted inferential claim

species_breadth.species_effect: for each of 79 frozen focal species, first average C-minus-R3 cell log-loss within each frozen confirmatory block, then equally average its 168 block means
report: number and fraction of species with negative effect
median, q25 and q75 species effect
five most negative and five most positive species effects with frozen species labels
species_breadth.pilot_prevalence_association: Spearman correlation between species effect and frozen pilot prevalence pilot_presence/1275
species_breadth.uncertainty: no species-wise significance tests; association is descriptive

past_isolation_strata.conditional_rule: only if raw Past_isolation in the exact safe Appendix 2 rows has exactly two finite unique values among confirmatory islands
past_isolation_strata.summary: for each raw Past_isolation value, compute equal-weight mean of within-block C-minus-R3 cell deltas using only islands of that stratum in blocks where the stratum occurs
past_isolation_strata.label: Past_isolation strata only; do not relabel as geological origin unless independently justified

forbidden: use these diagnostics to relabel the mammal result confirmatory
use a favourable subgroup to rescue a nonfavourable overall result
